title: Sr Product Manager
jd_excerpt:
We're Hiring | Product Manager – AWS & Generative AI

Location: Alameda, CA (Onsite)

Employment Type: Full-Time (FTE)

Are you passionate about building next-generation cloud platforms and AI-powered products?

We're looking for an experienced Product Manager with strong AWS and Generative AI expertise to drive innovative cloud-native and AI-driven product initiatives.

What We're Looking For:

Overall 14 Years of IT experience

5+ years of Product Management experience with cloud-native or AI-driven products.

Strong understanding of AWS ecosystem:
• Lambda, EC2, ECS/EKS
• S3, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB
• API Gateway, Step Functions, OpenSearch
• Amazon Bedrock, IAM, CloudWatch
• CloudFormation / Terraform

Experience managing cloud-based SaaS and platform products.

Hands-on exposure to Generative AI / LLM ecosystems:
• OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source LLMs
• Amazon Bedrock
• RAG architectures and vector databases (OpenSearch, Pinecone, FAISS)

Understanding of prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI use case design.

Knowledge of microservices, APIs, and serverless architectures.

Strong experience in product strategy, roadmap planning, product lifecycle management, and Agile delivery.

Awareness of AI governance, security, and Responsible AI practices.
